description_en: Queries the list of images that can be installed in a cluster
description_zh: 调用ListImages查询E-HPC支持的镜像列表
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc list-images --base-os-tag CentOS_7.2_64 --instance-type ecs.n1.medium --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListImages

parameters.help_en: The image tag of the operating system. The tag is used only for management nodes
parameters.help_zh: 基础镜像标签，仅管控节点使用
parameters.name: base_os_tag

parameters.help_en:
The instance type.

If a value is passed to the parameter, the list of images that are supported by the specified instance type is queried.
If no value is passed to the parameter, the list of images that are supported by all instance types is queried
parameters.help_zh:
实例规格。
该参数传入值，查询指定实例规格支持安装的镜像信息。
该参数不传值，默认查询所有实例规格支持安装的镜像信息
parameters.name: instance_type
